أَفْشَغُ A ram (K) whose horns go this way and that [app. meaning widely, or dissimilarly]. (O, K.) ―
-b2- And نَاصِيَةٌ فَشْغَآء A spreading forelock [of a horse]; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ فَاشِغَةٌ . (O, K.) ―
-b3- And رَجُلٌ أَفْشَغُ الثَّنِيَّةِ A man having the fore tooth projecting. (Lth, O, K.) And أَفْشَغُ الأَسْنَانِ Having the teeth disparted; (Lth, O, K;) having wide interstices between the teeth. (Lth, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
